requirements.text: The profile MUST add no Network canonical state or transition kinds.
A liveness claim MUST identify a separately composed profile that provides the required retained-export, delivery and target-observation capabilities.
Every guarantee MUST remain conditional on its explicitly declared fairness and environment assumptions.
Terminal resolution progress MUST remain an external pinned target-local Seed assumption and MUST NOT be represented as a Network- or profile-owned transition.
Activation of this profile MUST use the Seed-bound dynamic-profile mechanism independently of activation of any composed profile.
